name: October 15, 2026 - Adjourned Regular Meeting
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Mobilehome Park Rent Stabilization
  Commission Meeting

  Regular Meeting
  Thursday, October 15, 2026

Please take notice that the Regular Mobilehome Park Rent Stabilization
Commission Meeting of Thursday, October 15, 2026, is hereby adjourned to
Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 1:30 p.m.,

The Adjourned Regular meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at City
Hall, 23825 Stuart Ranch Road, Malibu, California 90265.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please call the City Clerk
Department at (310) 456-2489, ext. 296 or email cityclerk@malibucity.org.

Dated: October 13, 2026 at 4:00 p.m.

________________________________
Christina Muñoz, Deputy City Clerk
